Appreciate the handoff — here's an initial intake from Success/Implementation perspective (high level):

Success goals / acceptance criteria (to confirm with Opal):
- Pilot success: Response latency <= 600ms p95 for user-facing queries at pilot load (TBD on what their concurrency looks like).
- Relevance: mean NDCG@10 improvement >= 12% vs baseline (their analytics team will validate).
- Reliability: <1% errors in model API calls over 30 days.

Implementation milestones (draft):
- Sprint 0 (internal prep): 9/3-9/10 — internal prep, environment provisioning, access collection (Okta admin, network range, KMS decision). Owner: Tessa.
- Customer kickoff / discovery: 9/10 — scope mapping and tech intake. Owner: Monica + Tessa.
- Pilot deployment (staging): 9/20-10/15 — validate traffic shaping, caching profiles, basic eval sets. Owner: Tessa + Eng on-call.
- Production go-live (target): 11/15 — full traffic shift. Owner: Monica (success), Eng ops (runbook).

Risks & immediate asks: 
1) Tokens estimate seems high relative to their contract; need clear testing cadence to avoid overrun. Action: confirm sample traffic pattern.
2) If they request model quantization for cost, we need a dedicated kernel/infra slot — flagging with infra (Marissa).
3) Networking: confirm egress IPs and VPN/peering windows.

Internal tasks I'll create in Jira and tag owners: CORE-OPAL-1 (kickoff), CORE-OPAL-2 (network), CORE-OPAL-3 (KMS decision), CORE-OPAL-4 (eval set upload). Please add anything I missed.

I can take Success Lead as Ben proposed but would like Monica to act as the onboarding shepherd (coordinate stakeholders) and Tessa to run the technical plan.

Karthik
